A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same ADePT paper, including all 23 pages and Appendices A–E. Text, equations, Figure 1 and Tables 1–19 are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original ADePT benchmark results in Section 4 and timing, ablation and few-shot results in Appendix B, alongside explicitly attributed baseline results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendix B, including ADePT benchmark scores and component ablations.

M1.justification: Section 3.3 retains the same short soft prompt, token-shared two-layer network, adaptive embedding offsets and training objective. Equations (3)–(4) and the method procedure are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same GLUE, SuperGLUE, MRQA, MBPP and other dataset coverage. Appendix B also retains the same few-shot scenarios and unsuccessful GSM8K instruction-tuning attempt.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within corresponding main-text and appendix experiments, including full fine-tuning, PT, DePT, LoRA and the other PEFT baselines. No comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.4 and Appendices C–E retain the same models, splits, metrics, training budgets and settings. For example, MBPP still uses a 50–50 training/test split and 10 training epochs.

E4.justification: The cyclic-offset and embedding-magnitude analyses in Tables 1–2, longer-prompt experiment in Table 8, and Appendix B component ablations, sensitivity tests and few-shot analysis are unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 4 retains three-run averages with standard deviations, and Table 15 retains its three-run few-shot reporting. Neither version adds or revises run counts, seed information or statistical uncertainty procedures.

E6.justification: Numerical entries and qualitative findings match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 3 retains ADePT's GLUE/SuperGLUE means of 86.6/77.4, and Table 7 retains MBPP scores of 17.86/43.22 for CodeGen-350M/Llama3-8B.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations are unchanged, including the PT/ADePT attention derivations in Section 3.4 and the DePT derivation in Appendix A. Extraction-spacing differences do not represent mathematical revisions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about adaptive token offsets, expressiveness, parameter efficiency and performance across 23 tasks and four pretrained models.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and qualifications are retained, including the discussion of LoRA comparisons, inference latency, poor CB few-shot performance and unsuccessful GSM8K training in Appendix B.

D1.justification: The code URL, implementation libraries, model checkpoints, training procedures and hyperparameter information remain unchanged. Appendices C–E contain the same reproducibility details.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography retain the same works and research positioning, including the distinctions from DePT and Residual Prompt Tuning. No related work or novelty comparison changes.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2, 4 March 2025, to v3, 21 December 2025. The paper's prose, title, authors, section order and appendix structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 and Tables 1–19 retain their captions, formatting and placement. Visual checks show the same page organization; negligible glyph-position differences do not constitute a layout revision.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, empirical evidence, theoretical analysis, limitations and reproducibility information are unchanged throughout both PDFs, including their appendices. The administrative version/date update provides no meaningful overall quality improvement or deterioration.
